request: how do bike gears make you go faster?

beats.intent: A big front chainring with 44 teeth and a small rear cog with 11, joined by a chain
beats.narration: The pedals turn a big front gear with forty four teeth. A chain links it to a small rear gear with eleven.
beats.code:
stage.title("Bike gears")
front = Circle(radius=1.6, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.2).move_to([-2.5, -0.5, 0])
rear = Circle(radius=0.4, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([2.5, -0.5, 0])
chain_top = Line(front.get_top(), rear.get_top(), color=GREY_B)
chain_bot = Line(front.get_bottom(), rear.get_bottom(), color=GREY_B)
stage.play(Create(front), Create(rear), Create(chain_top), Create(chain_bot))
stage.add(front, rear, chain_top, chain_bot)
stage.label(front, "44 teeth", direction=DOWN, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(rear, "11 teeth", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The front gear turning once while the rear gear turns four times, marks on each
beats.narration: One turn of the pedals pulls forty four links of chain, and that spins the small gear four times round.
beats.code:
m1 = Line(front.get_center(), front.get_top(), color=ORANGE, stroke_width=5)
m2 = Line(rear.get_center(), rear.get_top(), color=BLUE, stroke_width=5)
stage.add(m1, m2)
stage.play(Rotate(m1, -TAU, about_point=front.get_center()),
           Rotate(m2, -4 * TAU, about_point=rear.get_center()), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("1 pedal turn = 4 wheel turns")

beats.intent: The gears beside 44 ÷ 11 = 4 and 4 × 2.1 m = 8.4 m per pedal turn
beats.narration: The wheel is two point one metres round, so each turn of the pedals carries you eight point four metres.

request: how much water does a dripping tap waste?

beats.intent: A tap drawn from rectangles with drops falling into a bucket
beats.narration: A tap drips once a second. Each drop is about a twentieth of a millilitre.
beats.code:
stage.title("A dripping tap")
pipe = draw_rectangle(stage, width=2.4, height=0.35, color=GREY_B, fill=0.8)
pipe.move_to([-1.2, 2.0, 0])
spout = Rectangle(width=0.35, height=0.6, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([0, 1.6, 0])
bucket = Polygon([-0.9, -2.4, 0], [0.9, -2.4, 0], [1.2, -0.6, 0], [-1.2, -0.6, 0], color=WHITE)
stage.play(FadeIn(spout), Create(bucket))
stage.add(spout, bucket)
drops = [Dot([0, 1.2, 0], color=BLUE, radius=0.09) for _ in range(3)]
for d in drops:
    stage.play(d.animate.move_to([0, -2.2, 0]), run_time=0.6, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_quad)
    stage.remove(d)
level = Rectangle(width=1.7, height=0.3, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_width=0).move_to([0, -2.25, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(level))
stage.add(level)
stage.caption("1 drop a second, 0.05 mL each")

beats.intent: The bucket beside 86 400 s × 0.05 mL ≈ 4.3 L a day
beats.narration: A day has eighty six thousand four hundred seconds. That adds up to more than four litres a day.

beats.intent: Bars of water wasted: 4.3 L a day, 30 L a week, 1580 L a year
beats.narration: Thirty litres a week, and about one thousand five hundred and eighty litres a year: several bathtubs.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [4.3, 30, 1580], labels=["day", "week", "year"], color=BLUE)
stage.caption("litres wasted")

request: why does the moon have phases?

beats.intent: The Sun's light from the left, the Earth in the middle and the Moon at four points around it, each lit on its left half
beats.narration: Sunlight comes from the left, so the Moon is always half lit: the half facing the Sun.
beats.code:
stage.title("Phases of the Moon")
earth = Circle(radius=0.45, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([0.5, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(earth))
stage.add(earth)
stage.label(earth, "Earth", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)
rays = [Arrow([-6.5, y, 0], [-5.2, y, 0], buff=0, color=YELLOW) for y in (-1.5, -0.3, 0.9)]
stage.play(*[GrowArrow(r) for r in rays])
stage.add(*rays)
c = earth.get_center()
spots = [c + 2.2 * np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a), 0]) for a in (PI, PI / 2, 0, -PI / 2)]
moons = []
for p in spots:
    dark = Circle(radius=0.35, color=GREY_B, fill_color=GREY_E, fill_opacity=1).move_to(p)
    lit = Sector(radius=0.35, start_angle=PI / 2, angle=PI, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).move_arc_center_to(p)
    moons.append(VGroup(dark, lit))
stage.play(*[FadeIn(m) for m in moons])
stage.add(*moons)

beats.intent: Each Moon labelled with what we see from Earth: new on the Sun side, full on the far side, half between
beats.narration: From Earth we see a different share of the lit half: all of it when the Moon is behind us, none when it sits between us and the Sun.
beats.code:
for m, name, d in zip(moons, ["new", "half", "full", "half"], [LEFT, UP, RIGHT, DOWN]):
    stage.label(m, name, direction=d, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A row of the phases as seen from Earth: new, crescent, half, gibbous, full
beats.narration: Over a month, as it goes round, the Moon grows from new to full and back again.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
row = VGroup()
for k, frac in enumerate([0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]):
    base = Circle(radius=0.5, color=GREY_B, fill_color=GREY_E, fill_opacity=1)
    lit = Sector(radius=0.5, start_angle=-PI / 2, angle=PI, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1)
    cover = Ellipse(width=max(abs(1 - 2 * frac), 0.01), height=1.0, stroke_width=0,
                    fill_color=GREY_E if frac < 0.5 else WHITE, fill_opacity=1)
    row.add(VGroup(base, lit, cover) if frac < 1 else VGroup(Circle(radius=0.5, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1)))
row.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.6).move_to([0, 0, 0])
row[0] = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.5, color=GREY_B, fill_color=GREY_E, fill_opacity=1)).move_to(row[0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m) for m in row], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(row)
for m, n in zip(row, ["new", "crescent", "half", "gibbous", "full"]):
    stage.label(m, n, direction=DOWN)

request: how do you turn survey results into a pie chart?

beats.intent: Bars of a survey: walk 40, bus 30, car 20, bike 10
beats.narration: A hundred pupils say how they get to school: forty walk, thirty take the bus, twenty come by car, ten cycle.
beats.code:
stage.title("Making a pie chart")
b = draw_bars(stage, [40, 30, 20, 10], labels=["walk", "bus", "car", "bike"])

beats.intent: The bars beside each share times 360°: 144°, 108°, 72°, 36°
beats.narration: A full circle is three hundred and sixty degrees, so each pupil is worth three point six degrees.

beats.intent: A pie chart of four slices of 144°, 108°, 72° and 36°
beats.narration: Cut the circle into slices of those angles: the pie chart shows each share at a glance.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
angs = [144, 108, 72, 36]
cols = [GREEN, BLUE, ORANGE, YELLOW]
start = PI / 2
pie = VGroup()
for a, c in zip(angs, cols):
    s = Sector(radius=2.0, start_angle=start, angle=-a * DEGREES, color=c, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_color=BLACK, stroke_width=2)
    pie.add(s)
    start -= a * DEGREES
pie.move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(s) for s in pie], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(pie)
for s, n in zip(pie, ["walk 40%", "bus 30%", "car 20%", "bike 10%"]):
    mid = s.get_center()
    d = mid - pie.get_center()
    stage.label(s, n, direction=d / (np.linalg.norm(d) or 1))
